shortBulletSummary: US-Iran peace talks are underway, easing geopolitical tensions, but with limited immediate boost to crypto markets.
Bitcoin is trading below $63,000, facing pressure from potential unwinding of the Yen carry trade.
A significant exploit in Coldcard hardware wallets resulted in over $100 million in stolen Bitcoin.
Robinhood received regulatory approval to offer cryptocurrency services in the United Kingdom.
Corporate holder Strategy sold Bitcoin, with its CEO acknowledging bear market conditions.
